payload.title: forgot password link is visible on the login form
payload.errorMessage:
Timed out 10000ms waiting for expect(locator).toBeVisible()

Locator: getByTestId('forgot-password-link')
Expected: visible
Received: <element(s) not found>
payload.diffSummary: src/components/auth/LoginForm.tsx changed 2 days ago (forgot-password-link test-id removed; link re-labeled and re-tagged password-reset-link as part of an auth-page copy update)

note: A 10-second timeout waiting for visibility is the textbook flaky shape. But the failure is 'element(s) not found', not 'found but hidden', both attempts report that identical failure with no divergence between them, and the domSnippet shows a 'Reset your password' link present in the DOM — not the missing forgot-password-link, but a different link that isn't there in an ordinary flake. diffSummary confirms LoginForm.tsx changed 2 days ago and touched exactly that link. Positive rename evidence, not a rendering delay.
